_about: Less common preflop spots. 'squeeze' faces an open plus at least one caller. 'cold4bet' faces an open and a 3-bet you are not part of. 'vsJam' faces an all-in after you have raised. 'vsLimp' faces one or more limpers ('raise' isolates, 'call' over-limps; the BB checks instead of folding).
